summary: Listed as a lookout in Walton County, Florida, in one directory with no date, design or history; no source describes the site now.

evidence.supports: the directory lists a lookout at Redbay in Walton County

notes_for_editor: Only evidence is a directory page on easternuslookouts.weebly.com that gives the name and county and nothing else. The story is short because the evidence is that thin; the editor may prefer to hold it. The directory does not say the site was a tower; the record's kind 'tower' is unconfirmed. Two web searches found no tower history. One search snippet pointed to a 259.8-foot commercial tower registered at Redbay (towerdex); that page returned HTTP 403 and it is not a lookout source, so it is not used.
